meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aWUmHOqW3cVzrMZTh_playbook
title: Flow 1
actions:
  Configuration:
    title: Configuration
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Loads observable enrichment types and parser ignore lists from asset configuration for downstream processing.
    on-success:
    - Build_IOC_Parser_Parameters: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Observable_Types_to_Enrich
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
    - name: Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists
      value:
        Regex: '{ $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.Regex }'
        IP_CIDR_Ranges: '{ $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.IP_CIDR_Ranges }'
        Domains: '{ $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.Domains }'
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 621a5f9d-9696-4611-8885-b5ad067b9507
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 7d619888-9efa-48d6-87bb-87648db9a482
  Build_IOC_Parser_Parameters:
    title: Build IOC Parser Parameters
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Formats ignore list parameters (regex, IP CIDR ranges, domains) by removing whitespace and handling null values.
    on-success:
    - Extract_Observables_from_Text_String: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      regex_ignore:
        title: Regex Ignore
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: 'variables.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.Regex ? variables.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.Regex : ""'
          data:
            variables:
              Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists:
                Regex:
                  $:ref: $variables.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.Regex
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ip_cidr_ignore_list
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      ip_cidr_ignore_list:
        title: IP CIDR Ignore List
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: $replace(variables.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.IP_CIDR_Ranges, " ", "")
          data:
            variables:
              Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists:
                IP_CIDR_Ranges:
                  $:ref: $variables.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.IP_CIDR_Ranges
        actionType: jsonata
        next: domains_ignore_list
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      domains_ignore_list:
        title: Domains Ignore List
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: $replace(variables.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.Domains, " ", "")
          data:
            variables:
              Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists:
                Domains:
                  $:ref: $variables.Observable_Parser_Ignore_Lists.Domains
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: regex_ignore
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Extract_Observables_from_Text_String:
    title: Extract Observables from Text String
    type: connector
    description: >
      Parses input text to identify and extract observables (IPs, domains, URLs, etc.) while excluding whitelisted patterns.
    on-success:
    - Serialize_Observables: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    action: swimlane_util.ioc_parser
    inputs:
      parameters:
        text_body: '{ $:ref: $inputs.text_value }'
        whitelist_regex: '{ $:ref: $actions.Build_IOC_Parser_Parameters.result.regex_ignore }'
        whitelist_domains: '{ $:ref: $actions.Build_IOC_Parser_Parameters.result.domains_ignore_list }'
        whitelist_ip_cidr_ranges: '{ $:ref: $actions.Build_IOC_Parser_Parameters.result.ip_cidr_ignore_list }'
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
  Serialize_Observables:
    title: Serialize Observables
    type: transformation
    description: >
      Filters extracted observables by configured types and transforms them into structured objects with type and value fields.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations:
      observables:
        title: Observables
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            (
              $observables := $sift(actions.Extract_Observables_from_Text_String.result, function($v, $k) {
                  $k in variables.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
              }) ~> $each(function($v, $k) {
                  $v.{
                      "observable_type": $k,
                      "observable_value": $
                  }
              }) ~> $reduce($append) ~> $distinct ;


              $distinct([ $observables ]) ;
            )
          data:
            actions:
              Extract_Observables_from_Text_String:
                result:
                  $:ref: $actions.Extract_Observables_from_Text_String.result
            variables:
              Observable_Types_to_Enrich:
                $:ref: $variables.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: observables
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
meta: {}
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Configuration
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  observables:
    $:ref: $actions.Serialize_Observables.result.observables
environment: {}
triggers: {}
